title: Lyra Direct Covid-19 Buffer Distribution
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck labware
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons 300 µL tip rack in slot 1, the Eppendorf 96‑well plate in slot 4, and the NEST 12‑well reservoir in slot 7, following the provided deck map, and ensure the Opentrons P300 8‑Channel pipette is mounted.

steps.title: Load process buffer into reservoir
steps.instruction: Using the Lyra Direct SARS‑CoV‑2 Assay process buffer, fill the reservoir columns; each column holds enough for up to 24 wells. For a full 96‑well plate, load columns 1‑4 with buffer so that 400 µL can be transferred to each well.

steps.title: Download protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Download the protocol bundle file from the source provided by Opentrons.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition (if needed)
steps.instruction: If your labware is not already defined, upload the appropriate custom labware definition file to the OT App.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Import the downloaded protocol bundle into the OT App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT App calibration routine to calibrate the tip rack, 96‑well plate, 12‑well reservoir, and the P300 8‑Channel pipette, following the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated distribution of 400 µL process buffer from the reservoir to the specified wells of the 96‑well plate.
